about: The bone map as remade in Blender on 2026-10-21 (Art/Blender/bone_map.blend, about 105 x 98 m inside its walls): the Terrorists start on the base in the south-west corner (Cube.025), SWAT on the one in the north-east (Cube.026); the one bombsite is the platform under the ribcage in the middle (Cube.022; only Decal_A, so ModelMap makes it a single site). The three platforms stand 0.57 m above the ground: ramps lead up through gaps in the bone-tree fences and onto the middle platform from the north, south and east. The pumpkins (Circle...) are settled onto the ground or a platform under their middle.
